translations.web: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
translations.bsb: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
translations.kjv: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
translations.asv: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah; He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
